description: Paid ($0.05 USDC on Base via x402, no free tier): the exact committed snapshots behind endpoint_spot_check's locked teasers: which payment terms changed in the last 30 days, when, from what to what, and the full hygiene checks. Pass the url and the commitment_ref from the free answer's locked_commitments; verify each revealed {snapshot, nonce} against its sha256 digest (docs: https://402xagent.com/docs#endpoint-report).

commitment_ref.description: locked_commitments.ref from the free check, e.g. cm-0123456789abcdef

include_current.description: also return today's stored data under current (not covered by the commitment)

url.description: the endpoint URL you checked, e.g. https://api.402rates.com/v1/ping

name: endpoint_report
